name: I Remember You
source:
After receiving an unexpected call, a young adult goat named Roady spends a short weekend at Wilting Tides, his hometown that he ran away from. There, he reunites with his childhood friend and former crush, a bear named Koby.

Will Roady be able to reconcile and reconnect with Koby, or will history repeat itself?

[From [url=https://chubbymeel.itch.io/i-remember-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只名叫鲁迪的年轻成年山羊接到一个意外的电话后，在他逃离的家乡威尔廷泰德斯度过了一个短暂的周末。在那里，他与儿时好友、前恋人、一只名叫科比的熊重聚。

鲁迪能否与科比和解并重新建立联系，或者历史会重演？

[来自[url=https://chubbymeel.itch.io/i-remember-you]Itch.io[/url]]
